name: building-blocks-icon-frames
title: Icon Frames
description: Small Tailwind icon containers that give icons the right amount of contrast and touchable presence.
useWhen: Small Tailwind icon containers that give icons the right amount of contrast and touchable presence.
avoidWhen: Avoid icon frames when a simpler pattern communicates the same content or action.
responsiveBehavior: Icon Frames uses responsive Tailwind utilities where present. Test its layout and interaction states at mobile, tablet, and desktop widths before shipping.
accessibility: Keep semantic HTML structure and visible text labels when adapting this component.
Preserve the component’s semantic HTML when adapting its visual treatment.
Do not use color, iconography, or position as the only way to communicate meaning or state.
